color.note: Dusk is the primary, listening-at-night theme; Dawn is its soft daylight counterpart. Every surface is a desaturated indigo-slate (Dusk) or warm lilac-cream (Dawn) so the album art and the two warm accents carry the colour.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Window backdrop behind everything. The deepest ground in Dusk, the lightest in Dawn.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar, player bar and other persistent chrome sitting on surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards, the now-playing panel and popovers: the raised content ground.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed grounds, slider tracks, icon-button resting fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline dividers between rows and panels. Never the only cue for a control; use line-strong for that.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (outlined buttons, inputs, unchecked toggles). 3:1 or better on surface-0 to surface-3 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0 to surface-3: track titles, headings, active nav.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-0 to surface-3: artist names, album names, resting icon buttons.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on surface-0 to surface-3 (4.5:1 or better): durations, track numbers, captions, placeholder text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lavender. The primary action fill (play button), selected navigation, focus of attention. Also usable as text or icon on surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icon and text colour on an accent fill (the play button glyph). Dark in Dusk, white in Dawn.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Translucent accent wash for the selected or hovered track row and the active sidebar item. Text on it stays ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Peach. The warm secondary accent: progress and volume fill, the equalizer bars of the playing track, the sun in album art. Text on surface-0 to surface-2.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on an ember fill (small badges, a filled chip).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Favourited (liked) heart and nothing else. Always paired with the filled-heart shape, never colour alone.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Cool accent for album-art variety and the 'available offline' tick. Not for controls.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Pale warm neutral for album-art variety (moons, horizon light). Not for controls.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The now-playing track title in the hero panel. One per screen.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings such as Made for you, Recently played.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Card titles and the track title in the player bar.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Artist line under the hero title; lyrics.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, track rows, sidebar items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Track title in a list row, active navigation label.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Elapsed and remaining time, track durations. Set with tabular numerals.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase section labels in the sidebar (LIBRARY, PLAYLISTS). Set uppercase.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Player chrome breathes: prefer space-5 and up between groups.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between controls in a group, row internal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar item padding, row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between transport buttons.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main-area gutters.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gaps between hero art and title stack.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom breathing room of the hero panel.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small art thumbnails in rows, chips, focus outlines on rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Track rows, sidebar items, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the player bar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero album art and the app window.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Sliders, chips, the progress track.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circular icon buttons and the play button.

shadow.note: Soft, wide and low-contrast. Shadows lift art and floating panels; rows and chrome sit flat.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the player bar.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and the app window on a backdrop.

tokens.name: shadow-art
tokens.usage: Album art in the hero panel.

tokens.name: glow-play
tokens.usage: The play button only.

size.note: Fixed sizes of player parts on desktop.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small icon buttons (favourite, more, volume icon).

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Standard icon buttons (previous, next, shuffle, repeat).

tokens.name: size-play
tokens.usage: The main play/pause button in the hero panel.

tokens.name: size-play-sm
tokens.usage: The play/pause button in the player bar.

tokens.name: size-art-row
tokens.usage: Album art thumbnail in a track row.

tokens.name: size-art-bar
tokens.usage: Album art thumbnail in the player bar.

tokens.name: size-art-hero
tokens.usage: Album art in the now-playing hero panel.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-playerbar
tokens.usage: Player bar height.

tokens.name: size-track-row
tokens.usage: Height of a track row.

tokens.name: size-slider-track
tokens.usage: Slider track thickness (6px while hovered).

tokens.name: size-slider-thumb
tokens.usage: Slider thumb diameter, shown on hover and focus.
